title: Typed tags and modifier algebra
foundation: Generic abilities, properties, masks and world stats
change: Declare typed tags, modifier stages, stacking groups, caps and source ownership.
mvp: One numeric modifier pipeline plus compatibility tags for a small skill family.
acceptance: Removing any source recomputes the result correctly; explain additive versus multiplicative effects and rounding.

title: Composable skills and supports
foundation: Generic abilities and item-granted abilities
change: Compose a base skill with validated behavior, cost, targeting and timing transformations.
mvp: One attack, three supports and a readable compiled skill sheet.
acceptance: Reject an incompatible support before spending; equip, unequip, respec and restore produce the same legal skill.

title: Causal triggers and bounded reactions
foundation: Script events, generic hooks and combat AI
change: Give triggered actions causal IDs, priorities, costs, cooldowns and recursion limits.
mvp: On-block and on-kill triggers with one declared action budget.
acceptance: Two mutually triggering effects terminate; summons retain correct ownership; restore cannot replay a committed trigger.

title: Explain a combat result
foundation: COMBATDEBUG and stat inspection
change: Show the applied and rejected rules behind damage, defenses, costs and immunity.
mvp: A plain-text calculation trace for one hit and one ailment.
acceptance: The explanation agrees with the resolved event and does not consume dice or alter the encounter.

title: Graph progression and masteries
foundation: Skill trees, prerequisites and respec tools
change: Add graph roots, choice groups, path legality, point currencies and readable neighborhoods.
mvp: A nine-node tree with two roots and one mastery choice.
acceptance: Refunding a bridge handles dependent allocations explicitly; old stable node IDs restore after a compatible content update.

title: Secondary archetype trees
foundation: Classes, ranks and achievement grants
change: Allow specialized secondary trees with shared or independent point budgets.
mvp: A boss-earned secondary discipline available to several classes.
acceptance: A character cannot double-spend one budget between the original and secondary tree; leaving removes only grants from that source.

title: Jewels that alter progression graphs
foundation: Item effects and progression prerequisites
change: Apply deterministic bounded graph patches, expansions or node substitutions.
mvp: One socket adds a small cluster; another changes a declared neighborhood.
acceptance: Removing or replacing a jewel produces a reviewable allocation migration; graph cycles and overlapping patches are validated.

title: Body sockets, grafts and charged glyphs
foundation: Body parts, wear slots, effects and charges
change: Provide optional body-bound modules with installation, capacity, charge and removal rules.
mvp: Two implant slots and one charged glyph on a declared body profile.
acceptance: Form changes, death and restore preserve legal installations and reconcile granted powers and reservations.

title: Versioned damage and defense pipeline
foundation: Combat formulas, resistances and generic damage/healing
change: Separate base values, conversion, scaling, hit checks, mitigation, ailments and recovery; allow different rule profiles.
mvp: One documented direct-hit pipeline and two conversion presets.
acceptance: A golden scenario distinguishes PoE1-like type history from PoE2-like final-type scaling and prevents double mitigation.

title: Action windows and tactical reactions
foundation: Windups, telegraphs, turns and boss phases
change: Declare commitments, reaction windows, interrupt rules and optional encounter lanes.
mvp: One two-step sweep with dodge, brace and interrupt responses.
acceptance: Each clock mode resolves the same declared opportunity; reading a paused menu does not spend its deadline.

title: Delivery geometry and trajectories
foundation: Rooms, exits, ranges and multi-target abilities
change: Define line, radius, chain, repeat-hit and collision policies over room graphs or optional local positions.
mvp: A directed bolt and a chain that cannot cross a closed exit.
acceptance: Target order is stable; friendly-fire and repeated-hit limits hold after displacement or a target disappearing.

title: Ailment buildup and interaction rules
foundation: Diseases, poisons, effects and saving throws
change: Add threshold buildup, decay, consumption, stacking, immunity and source snapshots.
mvp: Freeze buildup plus a strike that consumes a status for a payoff.
acceptance: Cleanse, phase transition, immunity and save/restore never leave hidden buildup or apply damage reduction twice.

title: Defense pools and recovery obligations
foundation: HP, shields, resistances and healing effects
change: Configure absorption, delayed damage, recharge, leech and death-prevention ordering.
mvp: One rechargeable defense and capped over-time leech.
acceptance: Simultaneous hits, damage over time and restoring pending recovery obey documented caps and cannot create infinite healing.

title: Reservation and maintained-effect budgets
foundation: Costs, auras, summons and active effects
change: Reserve named capacity for persistent skills, allies or equipment effects.
mvp: One dedicated command resource funds an aura and a persistent minion.
acceptance: Changing gear, form or resource maximum reconciles active effects atomically; suspended effects cannot continue for free.

title: Named resources and charge state machines
foundation: World stats, effect state and item charges
change: Unify pools, counters, gain/spend events, decay, reservation eligibility and UI presentation.
mvp: Heat, focus and a three-charge combat resource.
acceptance: Spend and gain ordering is defined; changing maximums clamps predictably; saved decay uses the selected clock.

title: Owned proxy actions
foundation: Summons, traps and combat behaviors
change: Distinguish minion, totem, trap, mine, persistent field and attached-brand ownership.
mvp: A placed turret and a triggered trap using a shared skill definition.
acceptance: Inheritance, threat, kill credit, legality and loot eligibility resolve from explicit fields rather than the nearest player.

title: Persistent minion loadouts
foundation: Followers, equipment, summoning and recruitment
change: Save a roster and equipment policy for persistent summoned actors without confusing them with profile recruits.
mvp: One recurring guardian with a fixed equipment budget and recovery rule.
acceptance: Death, dismissal, travel and restore do not duplicate equipment or exceed world follower limits.

title: Flasks, charms and reusable reservoirs
foundation: Invokable items, charges, recharge and cooldowns
change: Define reusable consumable-like equipment with refill events and optional condition-based use.
mvp: A healing flask and a cleanse charm with visible charges.
acceptance: Two activation conditions cannot double-spend; full-health behavior, cooldown and refill rules are inspectable.

title: Atomic weapon and action loadouts
foundation: Equipment, ability grants and custom commands
change: Switch equipment, conditional passives and active capabilities as one legal transition.
mvp: Two weapon sets with different skill and reservation arrangements.
acceptance: Refused swaps leave the old state intact; successful swaps reconcile minions, cooldowns and costs without free lingering benefits.

title: Momentum, combos and combat styles
foundation: Combat actions, statuses and martial abilities
change: Expose setup/payoff chains and momentum without requiring a sub-second input sequence.
mvp: A three-step optional martial combo and an encounter-based streak counter.
acceptance: Interrupted, missed or delayed steps follow declared reset rules; slow text input does not accidentally invalidate a turn-mode combo.

title: Forms, hosts and body capability profiles
foundation: Generic races, polymorph abilities, natural weapons and wear slots
change: Separate persistent identity, controller, current body and form-granted capabilities.
mvp: One humanoid-to-beast transition with explicit equipment and movement policies.
acceptance: Transform while injured, carrying equipment and in transit; restore either form with stable identity and no stranded gear.

title: Optional anatomy and local injuries
foundation: Race body parts and existing injury-related abilities
change: Add a persistent part graph with functions, coverage, health, disabling, severing and restoration.
mvp: One multi-headed creature and one injured limb with a documented recovery route.
acceptance: Vital-part death, area damage, severed equipment, regrowth and form transitions behave consistently; ordinary HP worlds remain unchanged.

title: Knowledge-aware senses and inspection
foundation: Senses, lore, journals, presentation and languages
change: Render names, appraisal detail and available investigation through knowledge and sensory rules.
mvp: Unknown alloy identification and a familiar granting a new environmental sense.
acceptance: Inventory, trade, help and combat messages respect the same knowledge rule; repeated inspection does not reroll or mutate state.

title: Elite traits and linked packs
foundation: Mob ranks, behaviors, scaling and encounter tables
change: Budget individual and pack-level traits with exclusions, telegraphs and readable counters.
mvp: Three elite traits and one linked pack with a shared objective.
acceptance: Reject impossible combinations; display the actual abilities; pack membership and shared state survive a partial defeat and restore.

title: Structured item modifier records
foundation: Data-driven affixes and item properties
change: Keep affix identity, tier, tags, group, layer, rolled values, locks and provenance separately from display text.
mvp: One equipment family with prefix/suffix capacity and mutually exclusive groups.
acceptance: Rebuilding, renaming or exporting an item preserves its modifiers and source IDs; illegal mixed states are rejected.

title: Inspectable loot generation policies
foundation: Loot tables, affix weights, catalog rules and generation seeds
change: Declare rarity, eligible pools, budgets, targetable rewards and optional bad-luck protection.
mvp: One seeded table with tier constraints and a finite guarantee counter.
acceptance: Preview and sampled runs agree about eligibility; unique caps and once-only rules hold across a real restore.

title: Atomic item and reward transactions
foundation: Item identity, saves, recipes and currency operations
change: Prepare costs/outcomes before committing input consumption, output changes and a receipt in one game-thread transition.
mvp: One deterministic craft with a canceled-choice and failed-precondition path.
acceptance: Save only at transaction boundaries; repeated completion after restore cannot duplicate a committed output or consume its inputs twice.

title: Declarative crafting operations
foundation: Recipes, workstations, salvage and known recipes
change: Describe add, remove, replace, protect, reroll and base-upgrade operations with eligibility and costs.
mvp: A three-operation workbench and one staged production recipe.
acceptance: Preview explains invalid targets and protected groups; failed validation consumes nothing; post-commit hooks cannot retry the craft.

title: Typed sockets and augments
foundation: Containers, receptacles and item-granted abilities
change: Define socket capacity, compatibility, connectivity, occupant identity, installation and removal.
mvp: Separate one physical augment socket from one skill support slot.
acceptance: Unequip, extraction, item destruction and restore preserve custody and legal grants; classic and permissive color policies are different presets.

title: Targeted crafting distributions
foundation: Recipes, materials and weighted affixes
change: Allow guaranteed tags, excluded tags and composable weight adjustments without bespoke currency scripts.
mvp: Two crafting ingredients bias a pool and one guarantees a modifier family.
acceptance: Explain the eligible distribution, detect empty pools and enforce guarantees without bypassing item restrictions.

title: Hidden modifiers and reveal choices
foundation: Identification, known recipes and menus
change: Keep an unresolved modifier and a stable reveal menu with discovery rewards.
mvp: An unidentified affix reveals three legal alternatives at a specialist.
acceptance: Reopening or restoring the menu preserves its options; choosing twice cannot grant two affixes or repeat knowledge rewards.

title: Destructive transformations and item lineage
foundation: Item copying, transformation and stable physical identities
change: Model corruption, recombination, split, imprint and restore as constrained lineage operations.
mvp: One two-item merge and one irreversible corruption table.
acceptance: Consume both source identities once; copied receipts cannot be reused; protected, bound and incompatible states remain enforced.

title: Material and quality channels
foundation: Custom materials, named resources, quality and durability
change: Add optional material properties, mixtures and quality channels with declared combat/crafting consumers.
mvp: One alloy with conductivity and one quality channel affecting only defense mods.
acceptance: Preview consumers and units; no unused trait is presented as a working benefit; resizing and repair check the same material rules.

title: Layout-based crafting projects
foundation: Recipes, puzzle primitives and room generation
change: Let adjacency or placement modify a crafting project's rules.
mvp: A four-slot arrangement with two adjacency bonuses and a visible output preview.
acceptance: Rotations and placement order have documented semantics; restore preserves the project; invalid combinations cannot consume components.

title: Progression attached to equipment
foundation: Item growth, attunement and ability grants
change: Give item instances or artifact families their own trees, investments and transfer rules.
mvp: A three-node weapon tree with distinct physical and mastery progress.
acceptance: Selling, copying, losing and reacquiring the artifact follows its declared scope; a merge cannot inherit the same investment twice.

title: Incubators and persistent mastery
foundation: Item growth, discovery and achievements
change: Count eligible use toward a future unlock or reward, optionally on a character/profile instead of the current copy.
mvp: An incubator and a weapon-family mastery with visible progress.
acceptance: Qualifying events count once; moving the item cannot move character-bound progress; restoring near completion gives one reward.

title: Tattoos and next-event omens
foundation: Traits, effects and conditional scripts
change: Replace a declared progression node or alter the next compatible committed event.
mvp: One reversible node tattoo and one crafting omen.
acceptance: Check eligibility before consumption; canceled previews preserve the omen; respec and migration remove only the tattoo's own source.

title: Special currencies and offer books
foundation: Currencies, banks, shops and pricing
change: Support expedition scrip, tribute, bargaining, deferred offers and stepwise merchant services.
mvp: A local NPC with three saved offers and one defer option.
acceptance: Offer prices/options survive restore; character and party balances stay distinct; a reroll is a committed paid action.

title: Optional asynchronous trade book
foundation: Existing shops, banks and exchange-rate support
change: Add a local order book first; a network economy would require a separate host/service and authority model.
mvp: NPC or campaign-local listings with custody, expiry and completed-sale receipts.
acceptance: Concurrent-looking attempts serialize; restore preserves escrow; no remote trade is claimed safe without authoritative settlement.

title: Loot organization, filters and shared storage
foundation: Inventory, containers, journals and profile-owned housing
change: Add filter/explanation rules and typed storage views; profile-linked inventory is a separate new persistence feature.
mvp: Text grouping and a recoverable hidden-loot view over existing inventory.
acceptance: Filters change presentation only; moving items between views never duplicates them; a future shared stash must have one physical owner.

title: Offerings with selectable outcomes
foundation: Receptacles, menus and transformations
change: Consume an authored offering for a stable set of alternative outcomes, with explicit stakes.
mvp: Offer one item and choose one of three generated replacements.
acceptance: Options persist after restore; abandoning follows a declared refund rule; the sacrificed item cannot also remain in inventory.

title: Escrow and deferred encounter rewards
foundation: Quest rewards, wave completion and saved script state
change: Represent provisional, banked, forfeited and claimed rewards separately.
mvp: A three-room trial that can bank rewards and resume.
acceptance: Leaving, failing, dying and restoring have explicit outcomes; replaying a completion event cannot claim the same reward again.

title: Collections and targetable item discovery
foundation: Achievements, item sets, journals and loot tables
change: Supply content templates for collection books, targetable components and distinct build-enabling uniques.
mvp: One six-entry collection with source hints and a nonmandatory completion reward.
acceptance: Only eligible acquisitions count; an ordinary copy and a cosmetic variant are distinguished deliberately; missing entries remain discoverable.

title: Loot rights and binding contracts
foundation: Ownership, party membership and item use masks
change: Separate pickup allocation, use binding, trade permission, source instance and expiry.
mvp: Personal reward claims plus one explicit equip-bound item.
acceptance: Two party characters cannot claim one shared entitlement twice; binding checks all transfer routes and survives restore.

title: Itemized expeditions and entry contracts
foundation: Travel, generation, instances and quests
change: Let an item select destination, seed, difficulty, modifiers, costs, attempts and participants.
mvp: One chart opens a seeded dungeon with two modifier choices.
acceptance: Entry consumes once; save/restore preserves remaining attempts and instance identity; missing members have a safe recovery path.

title: Discoverable endgame campaign graphs
foundation: Maps, lore, waypoints and generated layouts
change: Maintain discovered nodes, connections, story gates, influence and chosen content progression separately from physical rooms.
mvp: A twelve-node expedition atlas with one deterministic boss quest.
acceptance: Discovery and boss eligibility persist; shuffled physical instances do not erase progress; changing a preset invokes migration rather than silently reinterpreting nodes.

title: Reusable encounter director
foundation: Waves, arenas, boss phases, telegraphs, threat and resets
change: Coordinate actors, phases, objectives, budgets, interruption and completion through one saved state machine.
mvp: One three-phase boss and one defense wave using shared definitions.
acceptance: Target death, actor removal, retreat, party wipe and restore cannot duplicate waves or rewards; scaling is chosen once by a declared rule.

title: Escalating choices and cash-out trials
foundation: Menus, wave encounters and quest rewards
change: Offer increasing risk, objectives and modifiers while separating provisional and banked rewards.
mvp: Three rounds with a stop option and visible cumulative conditions.
acceptance: A canceled menu does not change stakes; failing forfeits only declared escrow; resumed trials preserve offers and modifier order.

title: Shrines and contestable auras
foundation: Room effects, switches, use scripts and timed abilities
change: Provide templates for an object that benefits its current holder or nearby side.
mvp: A guarded shrine transfers a timed benefit when claimed.
acceptance: Ownership changes remove the prior effect; leaving the area and restoring near expiry do not leave permanent benefits.

title: Guarded caches and chosen reward encounters
foundation: Containers, traps, loot tables and encounter scripts
change: Template an inspected reward object whose activation releases a budgeted encounter.
mvp: A craftable cache and an imprisoned elite with a known ingredient.
acceptance: The object cannot pay before success; repeated activation, target disappearance and restore cannot release duplicate populations.

title: Encounter ecology and death-driven escalation
foundation: Spawn tables, room state and script events
change: Accumulate local actions into a budgeted consequence such as a portal, infestation or escalating patrol.
mvp: A death cluster opens one demon encounter with an explicit cap.
acceptance: Off-screen events, chained explosions and restored corpses count once; escalation cannot recursively feed itself without a limit.

title: Possession and player-chosen empowerment
foundation: Effects, roaming mobs and conditional behaviors
change: Let an entity or device modify a selected encounter with explicit reward changes.
mvp: One roaming spirit and one opt-in enemy empowerment device.
acceptance: Host death/removal restores ownership and reward provenance; the same empowerment cannot be stacked beyond its budget.

title: Capture, menageries and encounter ingredients
foundation: Recruitment, summons, journals and crafting components
change: Store captured creature identities and classifications separately from live followers; consume captures in authored encounters.
mvp: Capture three creature families and use one capture recipe.
acceptance: Capture cannot also produce a normal kill reward unless authored; trading, freeing, consuming and restoring each capture conserve ownership.

title: Prophecies and conditional future events
foundation: Quest conditions, saved variables and delayed events
change: Register durable future promises with eligibility, priority, expiry, scope and conflict rules.
mvp: A prophecy adds an encounter when entering a qualifying region.
acceptance: Repeated room descriptions do not trigger it; concurrent candidates use documented priority; expired or canceled promises clean up state.

title: Layered areas and temporary realities
foundation: Instances, planes, room states and transport
change: Create linked alternate areas with a duration/resource budget and declared consequences on the original.
mvp: A room-copy expedition and an expanding rift over a bounded graph.
acceptance: Copies do not duplicate unique rewards or source knowledge unintentionally; forced return has a safe location if the original room vanished.

title: Roguelike routes, relics and run health
foundation: Generated rooms, quests, effects and save state
change: Add run-scoped resolve, boons, afflictions, relic loadouts and branch selection.
mvp: A four-room trial with two branches and one merchant.
acceptance: Bodily defeat and run failure remain distinct; quit/resume restores choices, costs and unclaimed rewards without rerolling.

title: Player-shaped dungeon topology
foundation: MAP layouts, generation guarantees, locks and quest state
change: Keep a construction project whose choices place, upgrade, connect or consume dungeon tiles.
mvp: A six-room temple project with one adjacency rule and a reachability preview.
acceptance: Each legal build has an entry and reachable exit; generation preserves required keys; restore retains both project and instantiated version.

title: Light-limited depth expeditions
foundation: Light, darkness, hazards, journeys and generation
change: Combine a route network, moving safe zone, fuel, depth, upgrades and optional hidden side paths.
mvp: A three-depth mine with flares and a return route.
acceptance: Fuel and darkness use the selected clock; the safe zone survives restore; depleted supplies cannot strand a mandatory campaign path.

title: Faction operation and relationship boards
foundation: Organizations, diplomacy, quests and NPC memory
change: Store members, jobs, ranks, relationships and investigation outcomes as an operation graph.
mvp: Four NPCs in two cells with capture, recruit and interrogate outcomes.
acceptance: Moving an NPC changes future encounters coherently; mutual relationships and once-only safehouse rewards persist across restore.

title: Objective arenas and team tournaments
foundation: Arenas, waves, parties and threat
change: Support objectives beyond kills, including totems, escort, territory and role assignments.
mvp: A two-lane totem match and a small saved tournament bracket.
acceptance: Friendly AI can pursue objectives; timeout, disconnect and full-party defeat resolve clearly; rewards do not require farming a stalled match.

title: Room-graph tower defense
foundation: Room links, summons, waves and resource counters
change: Define lanes, travel cost, build sites, tower upgrades and a defendable core.
mvp: Two lanes, three tower types and a finite wave schedule.
acceptance: Monsters progress by declared path rules; blocked lanes recalculate or fail safely; a text summary exposes imminent threats.

title: Build-a-boss and component-derived creatures
foundation: Mob templates, ranks, abilities and item components
change: Derive a creature's actions and reward budget from chosen parts.
mvp: Three component slots assemble a boss or a utility construct.
acceptance: Preview matches the resulting actor; incompatible parts fail before consumption; repeated creation cannot duplicate the same component.

title: Fog, pursuit and escalating area overlays
foundation: Room states, darkness, map fog and hazards
change: Apply an optional progress-driven risk overlay with visible intensity and an exit condition.
mvp: A five-room mist expedition where collected wisps empower a later encounter.
acceptance: Overlay state cleans up on exit; completion records do not stack indefinitely; map knowledge is separate from current visibility.

title: Settlements and multi-stage production
foundation: Housing, crops, workstations, organizations and calendar
change: Represent projects, worker slots, inputs, outputs, upkeep and bounded catch-up.
mvp: A quarry feeds a forge and funds one local shipment.
acceptance: Elapsed-time processing has a work cap; interrupted production conserves inputs; events are summarized instead of replaying thousands of ticks.

title: Prepared heists and extraction
foundation: Quests, locks, traps, stealth, followers and travel
change: Author blueprints, crew capabilities, alert, contraband custody and escape transitions.
mvp: A two-room heist with one specialist requirement and two escape routes.
acceptance: Abort, alarm, death and successful extraction settle exactly the declared loot; crew loss cannot trap the player inside an unsolvable state.

title: Optional invasions and scheduled events
foundation: Schedules, encounters, calendars and instances
change: Add bounded world-event controllers with region eligibility, announcement and cleanup policies.
mvp: A player-started event plus one game-calendar trigger.
acceptance: Quiet/off-screen regions do not accumulate unlimited events; restore does not restart an already completed invasion; participation and scaling are explicit.

title: Constraint-based challenge generation
foundation: Quests, masks, achievements and generated jobs
change: Generate a goal with optional restriction, taboo, forfeit and reward, and validate a feasible solution.
mvp: Three authored challenge templates including a noncombat delivery task.
acceptance: The generator excludes impossible builds/locations; restriction violations and completion race deterministically; rewards and forfeits apply once.

title: Composable activity presets
foundation: World settings, themes and generation templates
change: Combine selected activities through a compatibility manifest and a shared encounter budget.
mvp: Two compatible activities plus one conflict that receives a useful diagnostic.
acceptance: Composition cannot spawn two exclusive controllers or duplicate rewards; disabling a module leaves an explicit policy for existing saves.

title: General progression tracks
foundation: Classes, ranks, achievements, XP and saved scopes
change: Declare independent currencies, earning rules, curves, milestones, caps and reset behavior for several owner types.
mvp: A character discipline, an organization research project and an item mastery track.
acceptance: Each owner scope earns and spends independently; repeated source events cannot grant twice; old track IDs migrate predictably.

title: Specialty access and training budgets
foundation: Ability mappings, prerequisites, trainers and respec
change: Separate available access, minimum investment, point budget and effective proficiency; support incompatibility and antagonism.
mvp: Two affiliations contribute access to one skill with an attribute-bound budget.
acceptance: Leaving a source previews over-investment and resolves it by policy; temporary stat buffs do not create permanent free specialty points.

title: Affiliation compatibility and obligations
foundation: Organizations, memberships, masks and diplomacy
change: Add character-level exclusive slots, incompatible tags, membership grants and conduct rules.
mvp: One primary guild plus two compatible associations and a forbidden combination.
acceptance: Join/leave/rejoin validates the whole build and removes only source-owned benefits; standing, membership and disguise remain distinct.

title: Guild homes and declarative services
foundation: Guild scaffolds, NPC schedules, shops, banks and trainers
change: Describe service eligibility, location/time, costs, shared infrastructure and refusals.
mvp: A guild laboratory offers research and repair when the relevant NPC is present.
acceptance: The same eligibility explains help, menus and execution; closed services consume nothing; traveling headquarters preserve ownership.

title: Persistent companion and familiar bonds
foundation: Followers, recruits, affinity, summons and saved identity
change: Make reciprocal relationships own progression, capabilities, needs, commands and death/separation rules.
mvp: One mount bond and one noncombat familiar with growth milestones.
acceptance: Neither participant can be bound twice illegally; missing actors, form changes, death and restore resolve from declared policies.

title: Optional party formations and policies
foundation: Parties, ranks, target priority and threat
change: Add front/flank/rear/guard roles with explicit targeting and reaction policies.
mvp: Three formation roles in one encounter without a graphical client.
acceptance: Roles survive switching and travel; area attacks and bypass traits follow documented rules; world party limits remain authoritative.

title: Delegated missions and off-screen expeditions
foundation: Journeys, generated jobs and background work queues
change: Assign a bounded crew to a saved game-time mission with costs, outcomes and a return policy.
mvp: One shipment and one scouting mission with a deterministic seed.
acceptance: Restoring cannot reroll the mission; catch-up is bounded; members cannot simultaneously be in the party and on the mission.

title: Shared resource pools and contribution records
foundation: Clan funds, banks, dues and crafting assistance
change: Generalize guild power, research materials and maintenance pools with contributor/consumer records.
mvp: One shared power core funds a service and receives NPC/player contributions.
acceptance: A service cannot spend a pool twice; all actor identities remain valid across saves; single-player campaigns have a viable supply policy.

title: Voluntary rebirth and retirement
foundation: Character creation, achievements, profiles and respec
change: Apply a reviewable reset manifest and grant bounded legacy progress in a new generation scope.
mvp: Retire one consenting character to a new start while retaining an authored legacy choice.
acceptance: Show every lost/retained field; companion, quest, item and profile references migrate; cancellation leaves the original unchanged.

title: Patrons, favor and conduct
foundation: Deities, factions, calendars and achievements
change: Add favor events, portfolios, obligations, holy-day gates and optional portents to existing religious systems.
mvp: A patron rewards one conduct rule and unlocks a calendar-bound service.
acceptance: Witness/scope rules are explicit; favor cannot be farmed by replaying one event; leaving reconciles benefits without erasing unrelated standings.

title: Culture and identity lifecycle
foundation: Origins, creation steps, languages, races and vocabulary
change: Keep culture, upbringing, learned language, current body and adopted identity as separate sources.
mvp: Two cultures share a race; one character can adopt a language/community later.
acceptance: Changing culture does not erase unrelated skills or rewrite race anatomy; creation and later adoption use the same grant rules.

title: Season, hardcore and self-found profiles
foundation: World configuration, profiles and separate campaigns
change: Declare rule scopes, entry flags, trade/party restrictions and parent-scope migration.
mvp: An isolated local season and an optional hardcore-to-parent transfer.
acceptance: A transfer conserves items and progress by policy; self-found restrictions cover every transfer route; starting a season never erases another campaign.

title: Challenges, collections and personal records
foundation: Achievements, journals, discovery and profile rewards
change: Group accomplishments into optional collections, challenge sets and personal-run records.
mvp: A ten-entry challenge book with visible and hidden milestones.
acceptance: Rewards apply once in the declared scope; old seasons remain readable; no online leaderboard is required for local play.

title: Configurable death, ghost and life contracts
foundation: Downed/revive, checkpoints, death rules and corpses
change: Compose defeat, injuries, ghost control, resurrection, life counters and recovery services.
mvp: One ghost-recovery episode and one limited-life preset with explicit beginner protection.
acceptance: Save during downing, ghost state and resurrection; each restores safely and cannot consume another life or duplicate corpse equipment.

title: Discovery and latent advancement
foundation: Discovery properties, achievements, lore and known recipes
change: Let meaningful discoveries unlock disciplines, senses or latent powers under authored conditions.
mvp: Three lore discoveries open one noncombat talent; optional chance uses a stable event seed.
acceptance: Repeated reading gives no repeated grant; knowledge sharing obeys scope; a menu refresh cannot reroll awakening.

title: Households, estates and campaign legacies
foundation: Housing, furnishing, ownership, journals and organizations
change: Connect home permissions, household roles, collections, memorials and persistent chronicles.
mvp: A shared estate with guest/owner permissions and one adventuring trophy display.
acceptance: Guests cannot edit protected structures; transfers settle ownership and storage; a retired character's record remains readable.

title: Capability manifests and versioned schemas
foundation: World manifests, configuration and validation commands
change: Declare module IDs, rule versions, dependencies, conflicts, save sections and supported clock modes.
mvp: A manifest for one optional pack that can be inspected without activating it.
acceptance: An incompatible pack or unsupported save version fails before changing campaign state; diagnostics name the exact dependency.

title: Cross-system compilation and validation
foundation: Existing validators, masks and reference checks
change: Validate schemas, references, type/unit compatibility, dependency cycles, controller conflicts and bounded guarantees.
mvp: One command checks a support, craft and expedition together.
acceptance: Errors identify authored source locations; dynamic scripts are marked unknown rather than falsely proved safe or impossible.

title: Build, craft and encounter previews
foundation: PROGRESSION, CONSIDER, PRICECHECK and inspection
change: Provide non-mutating previews of legal choices, costs, outcomes and known interactions.
mvp: One build comparison, one craft preview and one expedition preflight.
acceptance: Preview consumes no currency, dice or once-only state; hidden information follows the selected creator/player view.

title: Bounded combat and economy simulation
foundation: PLAYTEST, TESTCHAR and fixture infrastructure
change: Add a deterministic headless harness with declared agents, budgets, metrics and stopping rules.
mvp: Compare two small builds against a fixed boss across a bounded seed set.
acceptance: Runs stop on stalled encounters or budget limits; reports separate observed distributions from exact analytical probabilities.

title: State inspection and event provenance
foundation: STAT, TRACEB, script traces and saved state
change: Show controllers, active grants, causal events, reservations and pending transactions with source locations.
mvp: Inspect one character, item, relationship and expedition ledger.
acceptance: Inspection does not mutate state; a failed transition reports the owner, rule source and recovery path.

title: Migration and compatibility tooling
foundation: Stable source IDs, instance IDs, aliases and manifests
change: Version new ledger schemas and supply dry-run migrations, missing-source policies and rollback summaries.
mvp: Rename a tree node and retire one module against a pre-change save.
acceptance: The old save is tested in a fresh process; refused migrations leave it untouched; uncertain name-based references never bind randomly.

title: Accessible text presentation contracts
foundation: Menus, windows, narration, colors, lore and help
change: Require plain-text alternatives, stable choice IDs, summaries and adjustable combat detail.
mvp: Render one skill tree, boss warning and loot filter without color or a graphical map.
acceptance: Headless and screen-reader-oriented views retain all actionable information; scrolling does not advance game time.

title: Content and interaction budgets
foundation: Difficulty formulas, rank presets and encounter budgets
change: Declare limits for stacked modifiers, triggered actions, proxies, repeated rewards and catch-up work.
mvp: A pack publishes a finite actor/trigger/loot budget per encounter.
acceptance: Reject or cap excessive compositions deterministically; explain which layer exceeded the budget; default worlds inherit no new scaling.

title: Reproducible random streams and scenario records
foundation: Saved campaign dice and generation seeds
change: Partition seeds for loot, offers, encounters and projects; record enough context to reproduce supported scenarios.
mvp: Reproduce one generated item and one expedition from a recorded rules version and seed.
acceptance: Inspection does not consume random state; canceled menus keep outcomes; reports state that arbitrary native/JS execution is not exact replay.

title: Creator templates and worked packs
foundation: Creator cookbook, generic editors and exported worlds
change: Supply small original content packs with declared contracts and complete create/play/save/restore examples.
mvp: A support build, a guild laboratory, a bonded familiar and a branching expedition.
acceptance: A creator can build and complete each example from the guide using the matching engine version; no placeholder command is presented as live syntax.

title: Optional pack composition and retirement
foundation: World resource overlays and configuration
change: Resolve namespaced definitions, overrides, dependencies, conflicts and saved-instance behavior when a pack is removed.
mvp: Enable two packs with one deliberate conflict and retire one while preserving a safe campaign path.
acceptance: Activation cannot silently override an unrelated ID; disabling describes what happens to extant items, quests, summons and stored progress.

title: Performance and transaction observability
foundation: Event traces, tick timing and authoring diagnostics
change: Measure bounded work, delayed transitions, rollbacks, queue sizes and duplicate-event suppression.
mvp: A report for the prototype pack's actors, triggers, transactions and catch-up.
acceptance: A stress scenario remains within declared work limits; diagnostics identify an offending source without dumping unrelated campaign/private data.
